title: [WebDriver BiDi] download process automation
body: Extend "handle as a download" algorithm for allowing automation via WebDriver BiDi. Specifically: 1. Invoke ["WebDriver BiDi download will begin"](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-download-will-begin) to possibly deny download or specify destination folder. Required for [`browser.setDownloadBehavior`](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#cddl-type-browsersetdownloadbehavior) command. 2. Report when download is ended via ["WebDriver BiDi download end"](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-download-end) and provide downloaded path. Required for WebDriver BiDi [`browsingContext.downloadEnd`](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#cddl-type-browsingcontextdownloadend) event. ### Refactoring In order to provide the proper events' order, the "WebDriver BiDi download started" was rename to "WebDriver BiDi download started" and was moved into "handle as a download". ### Specification As long as the download processing is non-normative, the generic description was used: * _"If the download is canceled by the user, by the user agent, or if an error occurs"_ * _"When the file downloading successfully completed"_ - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * Mozilla - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/52932 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * WebDriver BiDi: https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/pull/923 * Chromium: https://github.com/GoogleChromeLabs/chromium-bidi/pull/3427 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1970293 * WebKit: N/A * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
